claim_boundary: All exact predicates in this file are owner operational conventions. First-party Arjo/MMT evidence supports the surrounding concepts and hierarchy but does not receive exact-construction closure credit for these predicates.

fva.session_selection: latest confirmed pivot high AND latest confirmed pivot low known by 09:30 America/New_York

order_flow_stop_anchor.proxy: minimum 15m low from activation bar through second sting bar inclusive
order_flow_stop_anchor.role: owner operational proxy for low of relevant bullish Order Flow leg

purpose: Operationalize residual FVA, 2CR/run, 2-Sting, Order Flow stop-anchor, and target selection after OWNER_OPERATIONAL_FVG_V1 so Phase 6A can materialize occurrences without performance-derived semantic selection.

target.eligibility: target must be strictly above both second-sting touch and second-sting close entry prices
target.proxy: maximum high of all complete 4h bars whose end time is <= 09:30 America/New_York session selection time
target.role: causal prior-known 4h ATH proxy for documented next-ATH/HTF-premium context

two_candle_rejection.pair_selection: earliest adjacent two-bar pair containing a rejection; choose first bar if first rejects, otherwise second
two_candle_rejection.run_confirmation: first later complete 15m bar with close > rejection_high
two_candle_rejection.search_window: frozen WoO only, adjacent complete bars

two_sting.selection: first two qualifying distinct complete 15m bars in chronological order
two_sting.sting_predicate: bar.low <= FVA.zone_high AND bar.high >= FVA.zone_low AND bar.close > FVA.zone_low
